description: WA Road Crash Information (last 5 years) is an interactive resource (dashboard, viewer or map) listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Road Safety Data (National Road Safety Hub) group, published by Main Roads, WA. Crashes are recorded in the Integrated Road Information System (IRIS). The dataset provided is of crashes over the past 5 calendar years. Coverage is Western Australia, 2019 to 2023; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2025-02-24. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support road incident and emergency response analysis and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
